title: High water in Alexandria
summary: Love describes a flood when the Red River rose into the district and he left until the water went down.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Huh? Yeah, he called them madams. House lady, you know, blind lady. I worked in Alexander, I believe it was 1970 or 8, they had high water. The Bay Rapids swore up, you see, we had to go over a bridge to go the way. And the water got so high they had to move from downstairs to upstairs on the front porch. We'd go to wake and skiff. Man, the water got up to the top, the first floor, you know. You just get right out to skiff and go right in the building. The water went in the building one night, about one inch. And I left and come back to Plagman, you know. I said, I ain't going back up there until that water go around. The water went down, they had to rebuild, fix up, I went back.
